import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int r, c, n;
    static char[] s = new char[66];
    static long[][] comb = new long[66][66];
    static int[] cnt_a = new int[66];
    static int[] cnt_b = new int[66];
    static ArrayList<Long>[] partial = new ArrayList[66];
    static ArrayList<Long>[] partial_zero = new ArrayList[66];

    static void compute_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    static long get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long ans = 0;
        long aux1, aux2;

        for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                a_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void compute_second_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            if (check(conf))
                partial[a_here].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
            else
                partial_zero[a_here].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partial_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long get_coef(int conf) {
        int i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++)
            if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
                break;

        for (int j = i; j < c + 1; j++) {
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && ((conf >> j) & 1) == 1) return 0;
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && ((conf >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
        }

        int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);

        if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return comb[set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static int[] upd(int[] ans, int[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] < act[0]) return ans;
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) return new int[]{act[0], act[1]};
        ans[1] += act[1];
        return ans;
    }

    static long how_many(ArrayList<Long> data, long val) {
        int it1 = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        int it2 = Collections.binarySearch(data, val + 1);
        if (it1 < 0) it1 = -(it1 + 1);
        if (it2 < 0) it2 = -(it2 + 1);
        return it2 - it1;
    }

    static long compute_first_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        long act, coef, coef2;
        int[] ans = new int[]{Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0};

        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);

            coef = get_coef(conf);
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(partial[c + 1 - a_here], -act);
            if (idx < 0) idx = -(idx + 1);

            if (idx < partial[c + 1 - a_here].size()) {
                long val = partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    ans = upd(ans, new int[]{(int)(val + act), (int)(coef * coef2)});
                }
            }

            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx - 1);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    ans = upd(ans, new int[]{(int)(val + act), (int)(coef * coef2)});
                }
            }

            coef = 0;
            idx = Collections.binarySearch(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here], -act);
            if (idx < 0) idx = -(idx + 1);

            if (idx < partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].size()) {
                long val = partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    ans = upd(ans, new int[]{(int)(val + act), (int)(coef * coef2)});
                }
            }

            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx - 1);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    coef2 = how_many(partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    ans = upd(ans, new int[]{(int)(val + act), (int)(coef * coef2)});
                }
            }
        }
        return ans[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        r = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        String str = sc.next();
        for (int i = 1; i <= str.length(); i++) s[i] = str.charAt(i - 1);
        n = 2 * (r + c);

        compute_comb();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 66; i++) {
            partial[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partial_zero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        compute_second_part();
        long sol = compute_first_part();
        System.out.println(sol);
        sc.close();
    }
}
